hooks.name: Lyrics File Template Generator
hooks.description: Automatically generates a template structure when a new .lyrics file is created

commands.content:
SONG: [Your Song Title]
ARTIST: [Your Name]
KEY: C Major
TEMPO: 120 BPM
GENRE: [Pop/Rock/Jazz/Hip-Hop/etc.]
MOOD: [Inspirational/Happy/Sad/Angry/etc.]
THEME: [Describe the main theme or story]

[VERSE 1]
[Write your first verse here]
[Keep lines short and punchy]
[Aim for 4-8 lines]

[PRE-CHORUS]
[Optional: Build anticipation before chorus]
[2-4 lines typically]

[CHORUS]
[Your main hook goes here]
[Make it memorable and singable]
[4-8 lines]

[VERSE 2]
[Continue your story]
[Maintain similar syllable counts]
[4-8 lines]

[BRIDGE]
[Introduce contrast or new perspective]
[Usually 4-8 lines]

[CHORUS]
[Repeat your chorus]

[OUTRO]
[Closing section or ad-libs]

hooks.name: Lyrics Format Validator
hooks.description: Validates .lyrics file format and suggests corrections

hooks.name: Songwriting Metadata Checker
hooks.description: Reminds user to include song metadata (title, artist, genre, etc.)

commands.message:
💡 Tip: Add metadata at the top of your .lyrics file:
SONG: [Title]
ARTIST: [Name]
GENRE: [Genre]
MOOD: [Mood]

This helps the Songwriting Agent provide better suggestions.

hooks.name: Rhyme Scheme Analyzer
hooks.description: Auto-analyzes and displays rhyme scheme on save

hooks.name: Context Injection for Songwriting Agent
hooks.description: Injects song context when opening .lyrics files

commands.description: Extract and inject song metadata into context
